description: On a writable copy of the base fixture, Properties are created and appended on T.A (Caption Text 'A caption', Format Text '>', InputMask Text 'LLL', DisplayControl Integer 109), on T.B (DecimalPlaces Byte 2, Format Text 'Fixed', ColumnWidth Integer 1440) and on T.C (Caption as Long 5, DecimalPlaces as Long 2), with DBEngine.Errors after each Append. Every Property of the three Fields is then listed (Name, Type, Value, Inherited); after Close and reopen they are listed again.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
